main.title: What If Every Indian Got ₹1 Crore Tomorrow?
main.description:
8 AM. Every Indian gets ₹1 crore, tax free, even every baby. By month three, your crore buys what about ₹2 lakh used to, and the person who loses the most is sitting in your own house.
Why can't the RBI just print money and make everyone rich? Here's what would happen, hour by hour.

Real numbers in this video:
- India has about 146 crore people (UN, 2025).
- ₹1 crore is about 50 years of income for the average Indian (MoSPI per-capita net national income).
- All the money in India (cash, bank accounts, FDs) is about ₹315 lakh crore. Giving everyone a crore makes it about 47 times bigger in one morning (RBI data).
- NITI Aayog counted about 77 lakh gig workers in 2020-21.
- At its worst, in Nov 2008, prices in Zimbabwe doubled roughly every day, and it printed a 100 trillion dollar note (Hanke & Bostrom, Johns Hopkins).
- The RBI's inflation target is 4% a year. At that speed, prices double about every 18 years.

Chapters:
0:00 ₹1 crore, credited
0:36 Hour 1 · The buzz
0:58 Hour 6 · The showroom
1:29 Day 3 · Nobody comes
2:08 Week 2 · The numbers
2:47 Month 2 · Nobody trusts the rupee
3:20 Month 3 · The saver
3:54 This is already happening
4:29 What money can't print

This is a thought experiment: the numbers are real, the crore is imagined. The "₹2 lakh" uses the simplest money rule (same goods, about 47 times the money).

Who's the best saver in your family? Tell me in the comments.

Sources:
UNFPA, India population 2025: https://www.unfpa.org/data/world-population/IN
MoSPI / PIB national income, 27 Feb 2026: https://static.pib.gov.in/WriteReadData/specificdocs/documents/2026/feb/doc2026227806401.pdf
RBI Weekly Statistical Supplement (money supply): https://www.rbi.org.in/Scripts/WSSView.aspx?Id=28388
NITI Aayog gig economy report (PIB): https://pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=1837277
Hanke & Bostrom, Zimbabwe hyperinflation (JHU): https://sites.krieger.jhu.edu/iae/files/2018/07/Zimbabwe-Hyperinflates-Again-Hanke-Bostrom-.pdf
JHU Magazine, the 100 trillion note: https://magazine.jhu.edu/2009/08/27/what-hyperinflation-looks-like
RBI inflation target 2026-31 (Business Today): https://www.businesstoday.in/latest/economy/story/govt-retains-inflation-target-at-4-with-2-6-band-for-next-five-years-522390-2026-03-25
